_about: ML baselines = models of the original studies refitted with their ORIGINAL settings (no retuning), training seed 3407, one fixed set of predictions per baseline. Read by scripts/ml_baselines.py. The baseline compared with every LLM seed is chosen on the validation split (warfarin: lowest MAE of the 0.5-mg-rounded prediction; MACE and mortality: highest AUROC); ties -> the first model in 'models' order. The test split is never used for selection.

warfarin.features: configs/tasks.json warfarin.ml_features (17 columns; cleaning rules applied; missing: NaN for XGBoost, -1 for the other models)
warfarin.postprocessing: prediction rounded to the nearest 0.5 mg

ANN.note: inputs MinMax-scaled (scaler fitted on the training split)

mace.features: all key-map columns (numeric); original-study preprocessing: no imputation, one missing-value indicator per feature that has missing values in the training split, missing set to 0, no scaling

representations.TE: all categorical columns target-encoded (fitted on the training split) then mean-imputed
representations.Structured: chrom and chrom1 replaced by 13 binary flags each (llmbench/karyotype.py); the other categorical columns target-encoded, then mean-imputed

CatBoost.note: second target encoding of the encoded matrix (as in the original code)

AdaBoost.note: SAMME.R re-implemented (removed from scikit-learn 1.6); decision stumps
